disposition.change: Record the signed epic design for RWB-SVC-P1 covering RWB-P1-E1068-APP.
disposition.note: No epic-design sign-off is held in this story or in the cited sources; the record belongs to the epic design record, so no story edit.
Section 12.8 already names the RWB-P3-E1018-CON case fake; added the four contract-fake owners and marked the fake library version as Not specified (DOR-RWB-P1-E1068-APP-22).
Guardrails now name interaction.summary (DF-INT-011, section 11) as the one field classed personal, matching AC6 and BR4; the detcheck names no other field to reclassify.
MSG-P4-001 and MSG-GEN-006 keep the section 14 meanings; the standard wording and the replacement ID (CG-ALL-2326) are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P1-E1068-APP-9).
Section 9 states the read changes no case status and neither the story nor the cited sources define a status model or a transition, so AC13 would need an invented disallowed transition.

edits.old: - No personal data in logs, tests, events or prompts: a summary is never logged and never written to a trace; the PII access log records the user, the product, the case and the time of the read and never the value; test summaries are synthetic.
edits.new:
- No personal data in logs, tests, events or prompts: a summary is never logged and never written to a trace; the PII access log records the user, the product, the case and the time of the read and never the value; test summaries are synthetic.
- The one field this read classes as personal data is `interaction.summary` (`DF-INT-011`, read masked by role); the channel, the direction, the result, the promise amount and the promise date are not personal and are returned in full, and the read carries no other personal field (AC6, BR4; DOR-RWB-P1-E1068-APP-11).

edits.old: Thai text for each message follows decision DL10. MSG-P4-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P4-003 are raised by the access and case contracts and passed on; MSG-GEN-001, MSG-GEN-002 and MSG-GEN-003 name the field and are never filled with a data value; the min and max of MSG-GEN-002 are the parameter values of the read and not constants.
edits.new: Thai text for each message follows decision DL10. MSG-P4-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P4-003 are raised by the access and case contracts and passed on; MSG-GEN-001, MSG-GEN-002 and MSG-GEN-003 name the field and are never filled with a data value; the min and max of MSG-GEN-002 are the parameter values of the read and not constants. MSG-P4-001 and MSG-GEN-006 keep the meanings listed above in this read; the message standard's own wording for MSG-P4-001 and the new standard ID that replaces MSG-GEN-006 (CG-ALL-2326) are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P1-E1068-APP-9), so both IDs stay as listed until that standard text is published.
